parameters.query: UPDATE clusters SET vertical_panels = $1::jsonb, vertical_panels_cached_at = now() WHERE id = $2

INSERT INTO summary_cache (cluster_id, cache_key, cache_type, vertical_slug, content, model_used, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9) ON CONFLICT (cluster_id, cache_type, vertical_slug) DO NOTHING
